events.verdict: Post (GSW) attempts to jump vertically, but turns in mid-air and initiates body contact with Banchero (ORL) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Green (GSW) establishes himself in Caldwell-Pope's (ORL) and the two players immediately engage and disengage following the defensive switch.
Green (GSW) makes contact to Wagner's (ORL) arm, affecting his jump shot attempt.
Wagner (ORL) legally contests Podziemski's (GSW) jump shot attempt.

Green (GSW) and Isaac (ORL) come together in mid-air in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is marginal. Green then makes clean contact with the ball and any ensuing contact with Isaac is incidental.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) reaches in and makes illegal contact to Curry's (GSW) arm.
Looney (GSW) legally contests Caldwell-Pope's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Payton II (GSW) cleanly blocks Anthony's (ORL) driving shot attempt.
Green (GSW) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Banchero (ORL) commits a take foul on Butler III (GSW).
Carter Jr (ORL) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Curry (GSW) firms up in his defensive position and loses his balance on his own accord as Banchero (ORL) spins away. The contact between the two players is marginal.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) commits a take foul on Green (GSW).
Payton II (GSW) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
